jobs.name: 01_frames
jobs.prompt: Production game HUD sprite atlas for a musical fantasy action game. Use the attached reference ONLY for its HUD art direction: 1990s hand-drawn anime cel shading, elegant warm pale gold and ivory ink outlines, dark desaturated midnight-blue enamel, restrained burgundy and turquoise accents, clean graphic silhouettes, flat two-tone shadows. Match the reference's musical ornament shapes. NOT a screenshot, NOT an environment. NO guns, ammunition bullets, industrial metal, sci-fi holograms, bevelled photorealism, rivets, text, letters, numbers, captions, watermarks, grid lines, glow or drop shadows. Outside EVERY separate component use exact pure black #000000, so it can be extracted; do not use black INSIDE solid filled components (use navy #263347). Flat orthographic front view. Keep generous empty black gutters. EXACTLY 6 separate components in an invisible uniform 3-column by 2-row grid, strictly equal cell sizes. Each component centered inside its own cell, never crossing the cell, leave at least 12% margin on every side. Reading order left to right, top to bottom: Cell 1: a long horizontal empty navy instrument staff tray, width to height 5.3:1, thin ivory-gold parallel top and bottom border, rounded ends with very small musical flourishes confined to endcaps, continuous empty navy center, NO internal slots. Cell 2: perfect circular portrait frame, thin elegant gold and ivory ring with four small art nouveau curls on cardinal points, completely EMPTY BLACK circular center. Cell 3: perfect circular empty equipment socket, dark navy filled disk with very thin pale gold rim, simple clean center with no symbol. Cell 4: perfect circular compass bezel, single delicate gold ring with tiny diamond ornament above it, completely EMPTY BLACK circular center, no compass letters or lines inside. Cell 5: round navy pause button disk, thin double pale-gold border, empty dark center. Cell 6: rounded-square navy utility-slot panel, thin double ivory-gold outline, small radius corners, no ornament in center.
